svg.aria-label: Left: vendor bandwidth for the 16 GB cards, against the MS-S1 MAX measured at 256 GB/s. Right: the decode band each bandwidth implies for the two reference models, with the MS-S1 MAX's measured points marked. The bars are a prediction from measured efficiency; the markers are the only measurements on the page
svg.title: Left: vendor bandwidth for the 16 GB cards, against the MS-S1 MAX measured at 256 GB/s. Right: the decode band each bandwidth implies for the two reference models, with the MS-S1 MAX's measured points marked. The bars are a prediction from measured efficiency; the markers are the only measurements on the page
svg.desc: Left: vendor bandwidth for the 16 GB cards, against the MS-S1 MAX measured at 256 GB/s. Right: the decode band each bandwidth implies for the two reference models, with the MS-S1 MAX's measured points marked. The bars are a prediction from measured efficiency; the markers are the only measurements on the page — computed from the run archive, not drawn by hand.
